screen.holobuild.guide_hint: How everything works, without leaving the game
guide.holobuild.start.title: First steps
guide.holobuild.start.1: 1. Take the Blueprint Wand from the creative menu.
guide.holobuild.start.2: 2. Press G and pick a building from the list.
guide.holobuild.start.3: 3. Look where you want it and right-click.
guide.holobuild.start.4: The see-through hologram shows exactly what you are
guide.holobuild.start.5: about to place. SHIFT + right-click undoes it.
guide.holobuild.wand.title: Blueprint Wand
guide.holobuild.wand.3: SHIFT + right-click        Undo the last build
guide.holobuild.wand.5: Page Up / Page Down        Move up and down
guide.holobuild.wand.6: The wand reaches 32 blocks instead of the usual 5.
guide.holobuild.wand.7: A red outline means it does not fit in the world.
guide.holobuild.selection.title: Selection Wand
guide.holobuild.selection.4: The file is a normal Minecraft structure, so the
guide.holobuild.selection.5: structure block and other mods can read it too.
guide.holobuild.saving.title: What gets saved
guide.holobuild.saving.2: Air is left out, so a building settles into the
guide.holobuild.saving.3: ground instead of cutting a box out of it.
guide.holobuild.saving.4: Chest contents are kept, item frames are not.
guide.holobuild.commands.title: Commands
guide.holobuild.commands.6: They need operator rights and work in survival too.
guide.holobuild.survival.title: Survival
guide.holobuild.survival.1: The wand always shows the hologram, in any mode.
guide.holobuild.survival.2: Press G, then Materials, to see what you still need.
guide.holobuild.survival.3: Building in survival stays off until you switch on
guide.holobuild.survival.4: survivalBuilding - then blocks come out of your bag.
guide.holobuild.files.title: Your own files
guide.holobuild.files.1: Drop .nbt, .schem or .litematic files into the folder
guide.holobuild.files.2: the menu names when the list is still empty.
guide.holobuild.files.3: Subfolders work and show up in the names.
guide.holobuild.files.4: Create uses the same .nbt format - it just works.
guide.holobuild.craft.title: Crafting the wands
guide.holobuild.craft.1: Both wands share one shape, like a diagonal pick:
guide.holobuild.craft.2: an amethyst shard top right, a core in the middle,
guide.holobuild.craft.4: The core decides which one you get:
guide.holobuild.craft.5: diamond = Blueprint Wand, iron ingot = Selection Wand,
message.holobuild.short_confirm: Click again within 10 seconds to build anyway - it will stop where the blocks run out. Press G, then Materials, for the full list.
guide.holobuild.survival.5: Short of blocks? The wand names what is missing and
guide.holobuild.survival.6: waits. Click again to build as far as it gets.
tooltip.holobuild.site.clear: Clear the space for the chosen building
tooltip.holobuild.site.needs_wand: Choose the building with the Blueprint Wand first
tooltip.holobuild.site.undo: Undo it with the Blueprint Wand: SHIFT + right-click
message.holobuild.site_creative_only: The Site Wand only works in creative mode.
message.holobuild.site_no_blueprint: No building chosen. Carry a Blueprint Wand and press G.
message.holobuild.site_outside_world: That space sticks out of the world. Aim lower or higher.
message.holobuild.site_already_clear: Nothing in the way - the space is already clear.
guide.holobuild.craft.7: In creative just take them from the HoloBuild tab.
guide.holobuild.site.title: Site Wand
guide.holobuild.site.1: Saved buildings do not carry the air inside them, so
guide.holobuild.site.2: they settle into the ground instead of cutting a box
guide.holobuild.site.3: out of it. On a hillside that puts the hill in your
guide.holobuild.site.5: The Site Wand empties the space first. Choose the
guide.holobuild.site.6: building with the Blueprint Wand, then right-click.
guide.holobuild.site.7: Undo it with the Blueprint Wand: SHIFT + right-click.
message.holobuild.edit_nothing_matched: There is no %s in there - nothing changed.
message.holobuild.edit_would_empty: That would leave the building with no blocks at all.
guide.holobuild.edit.title: Changing a building
guide.holobuild.edit.2: takes every block of that kind out of a building.
guide.holobuild.edit.4: swaps one kind of block for another.
guide.holobuild.edit.5: The result always goes to a new name, so whatever you
guide.holobuild.edit.6: started from is still there if it goes wrong.
message.holobuild.edit_not_allowed: You are not allowed to save schematics here.
message.holobuild.edit_too_many: Too many blocks removed at once - use /holobuild erase instead.
message.holobuild.edit_nothing_removed: Nothing was removed - the file is unchanged.
screen.holobuild.editor_hint: Left-click a block to remove it, right-drag to turn
message.holobuild.editor_too_big: Too large to edit - more than %s blocks.
message.holobuild.share_exported: %s was built into the mod, so a copy has been put in your folder.
message.holobuild.share_how: Whoever gets it drops it into their own schematics folder.
screen.holobuild.folder_hint: Opens the schematics folder, so you can send a building to a friend or drop one in
guide.holobuild.share.title: Sharing a building
guide.holobuild.share.1: Every building is just a file in your folder.
guide.holobuild.share.2: Press G and click Open folder to get there.
guide.holobuild.share.3: Send the file to a friend. They drop it into their
guide.holobuild.share.4: own folder and it turns up in their list.
guide.holobuild.share.5: /holobuild share <name> says which file it is - and
guide.holobuild.share.6: makes one for the buildings that came with the mod.
